summary: Validated the new bulk-delete listings feature end-to-end. Backend: 6/7 pytest cases pass (1 skipped — canonical fixture missing from preview DB, unrelated to this feature). Frontend: 13/13 Playwright assertions pass across desktop + mobile (414x900). All review-request checkboxes are green: auth, 400 on empty, 200 with skipped on unknown ids, cascade, Delete selected (N) button, Cancel + Confirm toast, table refresh, select-all, mobile per-card checkboxes.

tested_flows.BE happy path + GET /api/admin/propertie: PASS (deleted=2, skipped=1; seeded ids absent in subsequent GET)
tested_flows.BE canonical fixture untouched: SKIPPED (4f5680df-... not present in preview DB to begin with — pre-existing state, our test only touched ids it seeded)
tested_flows.BE cascade (messages/bookings/admin_bloc: PASS via existing test_admin_bulk_delete.py (referenced, not re-run per main agent's note)
tested_flows.FE confirm-bulk-delete-btn removes rows: PASS (table refresh; bulk-delete-btn hides; backend GET confirms deletion)

code_review_observations: GOOD: admin.py bulk endpoint correctly uses $in projection on existing ids first, so the reported 'deleted'/'skipped' counts are honest and ghost ids don't blow up the cascade.
GOOD: ListingsTab.jsx renders the confirmation as a custom toast (not window.confirm) so it carries the required data-testids and works inside Playwright.

MINOR (cosmetic): the bulk-delete success toast triggers a refetch via the SWR cache invalidation, but the local selectedPropIds is cleared optimistically before the network round trip — consider awaiting the API response before clearing, so a backend 5xx doesn't leave the UI looking like a successful delete (the existing catch block does show an error toast, so impact is small).

MINOR: BulkDeletePropertiesRequest.property_ids has no max-length cap. A malicious/curious admin could submit 100k ids and trigger an expensive multi-collection delete_many. Consider Field(..., max_items=500) or chunking.

MINOR: The `Delete selected (N)` button text uses a leading space (' Delete selected (2)') from the icon spacing — purely cosmetic from a test standpoint; t() key 'admin.deleteSelected' resolves correctly in i18n English.
action_items: (OPTIONAL) Cap BulkDeletePropertiesRequest.property_ids length (e.g., 500) to prevent expensive deletes on accidental huge selections.
(OPTIONAL) Await API success before clearing selectedPropIds in ListingsTab.bulkDelete() so a 5xx leaves the selection intact for retry.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical defects. Endpoint properly enforces admin RBAC, validates non-empty input, normalises existing-vs-ghost ids, and cascades cleanup across all referenced collections plus the featured list and sublease detach. Frontend correctly gates the bulk bar on selectedPropIds.size > 0 and surfaces a testable confirm-or-cancel toast.

seed_data_creation: All test properties created via POST /api/properties as owner@test.com (title prefix TEST_bulk_delete_ui_*, TEST_bulk_selectall_*, TEST_bulk_mobile_*), then deleted via the very endpoint under test. property_type='apartment' is required by the PropertyCreate schema (not just rental_type). Canonical fixture 4f5680df-82a1-4af4-8649-eacc0a629214 was never in the preview DB during this run — no canonical data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To regress this feature: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_admin_bulk_delete_http.py /app/backend/tests/test_admin_bulk_delete.py -v`. The HTTP file pulls REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (backend/.env doesn't have it). Cloudflare blocks Python's default urllib User-Agent on this preview ('error code: 1010') — always use `requests` (default UA is fine) or set a Chrome UA on urllib. The login modal lives at /auth/login (route param), not /login. Property creation requires both rental_type AND property_type — the latter is easy to miss. The bulk action bar in ListingsTab only mounts when selectedPropIds.size > 0, so feel free to assert is_visible=False as a baseline before clicking checkboxes.
